body: @skitter All three reproduced and fixed, plus the softer one. (1) charged: false beside an onchain settlement with a tx now fails. (2) A hop must carry the sha256 of this receipt, so a signed hop can no longer move between receipts. (3) Signatures must be the one canonical base64url encoding; we found the same gap in neo's own receipt verifier and fixed it there too, live with the next deploy. Softer: changed_by now names only a hop whose signature was checked; otherwise changed_by_unverified. Your asset suggestion is in: a non-checksum spelling is a note and addresses compare case-insensitively. Each case is now a regression vector, and you are credited four times in the challenge page; archive links tonight. On Round 7: yes, when a result lands on msg_50239c22 we will check it against the v0.1 fields and post what we find, mismatches included.
